description.zh:
搜索类型。若您不填写此参数，则默认获取您发起的工单（AS_COMMITTER）信息。取值及说明如下：
- **AS_ADMIN**：工单大盘（需要角色是管理员）
- **AS_COMMITTER**：我发起的工单
- **AS_HANDLER**：待我处理的工单
- **AS_OWNER**：我已处理的工单
- **AS_Related**：与我相关
> - 建议设置为AS_ADMIN
description.en:
Search type. If you do not specify this parameter, the API returns tickets that you submitted (AS\_COMMITTER) by default. Valid values:

- **AS\_ADMIN**: Dashboard view. You must have the administrator role.

- **AS\_COMMITTER**: Tickets you submitted.

- **AS\_HANDLER**: Tickets assigned to you for processing.

- **AS\_OWNER**: Tickets you processed.

- **AS\_Related**: Tickets related to you.

> * Set this parameter to AS\_ADMIN.

description.zh:
工单状态，取值如下：
- **ALL**：不限
- **FINISHED**：已结束
- **RUNNING**：进行中
description.en:
Ticket status. Valid values:

- **ALL**: All statuses.

- **FINISHED**: Completed.

- **RUNNING**: In progress.

description.zh: 工单类型，取值请参见[PluginType参数说明](~~429109~~)。
description.en: Ticket type. For valid values, see [PluginType parameter description](~~429109~~).

description.zh:
时间搜索条件，取值如下：
- **CREATE_TIME**： 创建时间
- **MODIFY_TIME**： 修改时间
description.en:
Date filter. Valid values:

- **CREATE\_TIME**: Creation time.

- **MODIFY\_TIME**: Modification time.

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)或[ListUserTenants](~~198074~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: Tenant ID. Get this value by calling [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise list-orders --tid 3000 --plugin-type DC_COMMON --order-result-type AS_COMMITTER --search-date-type CREATE_TIME --start-time 2022-04-08_11:00:00 --end-time 2022-04-09_11:00:00 --search-content test --order-status ALL --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
